zh.label: 最新版本
zh.title: 磁力桌面扇形收纳与渐进浏览
changes: 扇子式收放；扇面容量 1–100 张，每组最多 10 张
默认 10 张不显示切换器，截图盒中的图片不参与扇面分组计数
全集每页 20 张，支持跳页、旁侧预览和定位到扇面
修复右键菜单失效、闪退、悬浮穿透和收起抢输入焦点
桌面贴图可整体居中并保留相对位置，浏览分组不移动桌面贴图
磁力桌面依赖截图历史；应用与 DMG 已通过 Apple 公证

en.label: Latest
en.title: Magnetic Desktop fan storage and progressive browsing
changes: Folding fan animation; capacity of 1–100 screenshots, with up to 10 per group.
The default 10-image fan has no switcher; boxed screenshots are excluded from fan groups and counts.
Browse all screenshots in pages of 20, with page selection, side previews and location in the fan.
Fixed unresponsive context menus, crashes, hover through the box, and folding that interrupted input focus.
Center desktop pins as a group while preserving relative positions; browsing groups keeps desktop pins in place.
Magnetic Desktop requires screenshot history. The app and DMG are Apple-notarized.
